contribution._instruction: Add all individual, organisational, or consortial contributions to this project.

description._instruction: Enter a description of this project.

fullName._instruction: Enter a descriptive full name (or title) for this project.

hasPart._instruction: Add all research product (versions) that are part of this project.

homepage._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifier (IRI) to the homepage of this project.

shortName._instruction: Enter a short name (or alias) for this project that could be used as a shortened display title (e.g., for web services with too little space to display the full name).

type._instruction: Add the type of this project (e.g., research project, grant project).
